name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta Province of Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts a large Measured and Indicated resource of approximately 186 Moz silver and 1.6 Moz gold, with a Definitive Feasibility Study targeted for completion in Q1 2026. The company received RIGI approval from the Argentine government and is advancing toward a production decision.
